evals.prompt: My ~/work/billing-api proration change is complete on task/proration and its gates are green. Is it ready to merge? Review it first.
evals.expected_output: An independent review of the frozen state (correctness, coverage, yagni, silent failures) with a merge/no-merge verdict — the diff read fresh, not a rubber stamp of the author's summary.

evals.prompt: I am halfway through the proration work in ~/work/billing-api, tests are red, and I will keep going either way. Request a code review of the current state before I continue.
evals.expected_output: Declines the full review (or gives a bounded steer labeled as such): an unfinished, knowingly-red checkpoint is not a reviewable state — review happens at a done boundary.
